newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway stocks dip on Bruntland resignation.
newsitem.headline: Norway stocks dip on Bruntland resignation.

text.p: Norwegian shares fell on Wednesday as a result of Prime Minister Gro Harlem Brundtland's surprise resignation, which left the market uncertain, dealers said.
The Oslo Total index slumped immediately after Brundtland's announcement in the morning, but gained some ground and finished 0.79 percent lower at 869.54 points,
Turnover was a healthy 848 million crowns.

Political analysts said markets were waiting to see if premier-designate Thorbjoern Jagland would have the political clout that the veteran Brundtland has had in the ruling Labour Party and a hostile parliament.
But one dealer said the downturn was also a reaction to Wall Street losses.
Industrial giant Norsk Hydro, which slipped after reporting disappointing third-quarter results on Monday, continued a downward trend, closing 1.2 percent lower at 298 crowns.
Food-based conglomerate Orkla A shares fell 1.5 percent to 403 crowns.
